## Type

- [ ] feat — new capability
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] chore — tooling / deps / cleanup
- [ ] refactor — behavior-preserving restructure
- [ ] test — tests only

## Checklist

- [ ] Small enough to review in one sitting
- [ ] No secrets, no committed build/scratch output
